about.title: About us
about.heroText: Maheshwari Krishi Sewa Kendra is a licensed agri-input store on M.G. Road, Sailana. We supply farmers in the area with quality seeds, plant tonics, fodder seeds and other farm inputs at the right price — along with the right advice.
story: A Malwa farmer's hard work pays off fully only when the seed is good, the input is right, and it is used at the right time in the right amount. So we don't just sell products — we understand each farmer's crop, soil and problem, and advise accordingly.
The same service is now online. Without visiting the shop you can see products and prices, place an order, and pay cash on delivery. If you have a question, one call or WhatsApp is enough.

delivery.a: Currently to selected PIN codes in and around Sailana and Ratlam. Enter your PIN code at checkout to see availability and timing. The full list is in our shipping policy.

payment.a: Cash on Delivery for now — pay when your order arrives. Online payment by UPI and card is coming soon.

genuine.a: Yes. We are a licensed seller (licence no. 890). Every product is recorded with batch number and expiry, and every order comes with a GST bill.

track.q: How do I track my order?
track.a: Enter your order number and mobile number on the "Track order" page. We also send updates on WhatsApp.

damaged.q: What if a product arrives damaged or wrong?
damaged.a: WhatsApp us a photo of the pack within 48 hours of delivery. After checking we'll replace it or refund you.

advice.q: Which product is right for my crop?
advice.a: Filter the product list by crop, or call/WhatsApp us — tell us the crop, its age and the problem, and we'll suggest the right product and dose.
